Name: Coop Join Port
Description: UDP port coop clients connect to. Written into server-config.json as 'port'. Forward this for direct connect.

Name: Coop Join Port +1
Description: Second UDP port the server uses. Must always be the Coop Join Port + 1 - if you change the join port, change this to match.

Name: Engine Port
Description: Port the Bannerlord engine is started as a custom server on (--port). Internal only - players do NOT connect to this. Just needs to be unique per instance.
